```python
def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    if not kwargs:
        kwargs = {}

    section = []
    section.append('   REMEDIATIONS')

    if is_using_api_key():
        for pkg_name, rem_versions in remediations.items():
            for spec, rem in rem_versions.items():
                vulns_found = rem.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
                version = rem.get('version', '')
                recommended_version = rem.get('recommended_version', None)
                closest_secure = rem.get('closest_secure_version', {})
                other_recommended = rem.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
                more_info_url = rem.get('more_info_url', '')

                content = f'\n-> {pkg_name} version {version} was found, which has {vulns_found} vulnerabilit{"y" if vulns_found == 1 else "ies"}\n'

                if recommended_version:
                    content += f'   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {recommended_version}\n'

                content += f'\n{" " * (columns - 2)}\n'

                if recommended_version:
                    rec_msg = f'   We recommend updating to version {recommended_version} of {pkg_name}.'
                    if other_recommended:
                        rec_msg += f' Other versions\n   without known vulnerabilities are: {", ".join(str(v) for v in other_recommended)}'
                    content += rec_msg + '\n'

                content += f'\n{" " * (columns - 2)}\n'

                content += f'   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit\n'
                content += f'   {more_info_url}\n'
                content += f'   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.\n'
                content += f'\n{" " * (columns - 2)}'

                section.append(content)
    else:
        total_vulns = sum(
            rem.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            for pkg_versions in remediations.values()
            for rem in pkg_versions.values()
        )
        pkg_count = len(remediations)

        content = f'\n  {total_vulns} vulnerabilit{"y was" if total_vulns == 1 else "ies were"} reported in {pkg_count} package{"" if pkg_count == 1 else "s"}. For detailed remediation & fix \n  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. \n'
        section.append(content)

    section.append('+' + '=' * (columns - 2) + '+')

    return section
```

```python
def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if color:
        text = click.style(text, fg=color)

    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=columns,
        initial_indent=indent + start_line_decorator,
        subsequent_indent=sub_indent + start_line_decorator if sub_indent else indent + start_line_decorator,
        max_lines=max_lines,
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False,
    )

    lines = wrapper.wrap(text)

    if not lines:
        return start_line_decorator + end_line_decorator

    result_lines = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if i == len(lines) - 1:
            result_lines.append(line + end_line_decorator)
        else:
            result_lines.append(line)

    return '\n'.join(result_lines)
```

```python
def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()

    styled_items = []
    plain_items = []

    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        scanned_paths = getattr(ctx, 'scanned_full_path', [])
        if not scanned_paths:
            msg = 'No locations found in the environment'
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': msg}])
            plain_items.append(msg)
        else:
            for path in scanned_paths:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {path}'}])
                plain_items.append(path)

    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file', None)
        if file_obj:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(file_obj.name)

    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        for file_obj in files:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(file_obj.name)

    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = getattr(ctx, 'packages', [])
        if not packages:
            msg = 'No found packages in stdin'
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': msg}])
            plain_items.append(msg)
        else:
            for pkg in packages:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
                plain_items.append(pkg.name)

    return styled_items, plain_items
```

```python
def build_report_brief_section(columns: Optional[int]=None,
    primary_announcement: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, report_type: int=1,
    **kwargs: Any) ->str:
    brief_info = get_report_brief_info(as_dict=False, report_type=report_type, **kwargs)

    if not columns:
        columns = get_terminal_size().columns

    section = ''

    for line_items in brief_info:
        line_text = ''
        for item in line_items:
            if item.get('style', False):
                line_text += click.style(item.get('value', ''), bold=True)
            else:
                line_text += item.get('value', '')

        section += format_long_text(line_text, columns=columns, start_line_decorator=' ', end_line_decorator=' ') + '\n'

    if primary_announcement:
        try:
            announcement_content = build_primary_announcement(primary_announcement, columns=columns)
            section += announcement_content
        except (ValueError, Exception):
            pass

    return section
```

```python
def build_using_sentence(account: Optional[str], key: Optional[str], db:
    Optional[str]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if account:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using Safety\'s '},
                {'style': True, 'value': 'commercial API'},
                {'style': False, 'value': ' with account '},
                {'style': True, 'value': account}]
    elif key:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using Safety\'s '},
                {'style': True, 'value': 'commercial API'},
                {'style': False, 'value': ' with key '},
                {'style': True, 'value': key[:4] + '***'}]
    elif db:
        if is_a_remote_mirror(db):
            return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using a remote mirror: '},
                    {'style': True, 'value': db}]
        else:
            return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using a local database: '},
                    {'style': True, 'value': db}]
    else:
        return [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using Safety\'s '},
                {'style': True, 'value': 'free database'},
                {'style': False, 'value': ' (updated once a month)'}]
```

```python
def get_report_brief_info(as_dict: bool=False, report_type: int=1, **kwargs:
    Any):
    ctx = SafetyContext()

    if as_dict:
        telemetry = build_telemetry_data(telemetry=kwargs.get('telemetry', True))
        git = build_git_data()
        return {
            'scan_target': ctx.params.get('scanning_target', '-'),
            'scanned': [item for sublist, plain in [get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(ctx.params.get('scanning_target', 'environment'))] for item in plain] if ctx.params else [],
            'api_key': bool(ctx.key),
            'local_database_path_used': ctx.db,
            'safety_version': get_safety_version(),
            'timestamp': str(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')),
            'packages_found': len(ctx.packages) if ctx.packages else 0,
            'telemetry': telemetry,
            'git': git,
        }

    scanning_target = ctx.params.get('scanning_target', 'environment') if ctx.params else 'environment'

    policy_file = ctx.params.get('policy_file', None) if ctx.params else None
    safety_policy_used = []
    if policy_file:
        safety_policy_used = [
            {'style': False, 'value': '\nScanning using a security policy file'},
            {'style': True, 'value': ' {0}'.format(policy_file)},
        ]

    if report_type == 1:
        scan_type_text = 'Vulnerabilities'
    else:
        scan_type_text = 'Licenses'

    action_executed = [
        {'style': True, 'value': 'Scanning dependencies'},
        {'style': False, 'value': ' in your '},
        {'style': True, 'value': scanning_target + ':'},
    ]

    scanned_items, plain_items = get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target)

    nl = [{'style': False, 'value': ''}]

    key = ctx.key if ctx.key else None
    account = ctx.account if hasattr(ctx, 'account') else None
    db = ctx.db if ctx.db else None

    using_sentence = build_using_sentence(account, key, db)
    packages = ctx.packages if ctx.packages else []
    scanned_count_sentence = build_scanned_count_sentence(packages)

    now = str(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))
    timestamp = [{'style': False, 'value': 'Timestamp '}, {'style': True, 'value': now}]

    brief_info = [[{'style': False, 'value': 'Safety '},
                   {'style': True, 'value': 'v' + get_safety_version()},
                   {'style': False, 'value': ' is scanning for '},
                   {'style': True, 'value': scan_type_text},
                   {'style': True, 'value': '...'}] + safety_policy_used,
                  action_executed
                  ] + [nl] + scanned_items + [nl] + [using_sentence] + [scanned_count_sentence] + [timestamp]

    add_warnings_if_needed(brief_info)

    return brief_info
```
